biomewaypoints.config.title: Biome Waypoints
biomewaypoints.config.biomes.desc: Ticked biomes are searched for, and their nearest place becomes a waypoint. Untick a biome to skip it. A biome turned off under Display (or in the list of waypoints) is not searched for either.
biomewaypoints.config.borderLines.desc: Thin lines on the ground show where the biomes around you meet (within 64 blocks, fainter farther away). Not in the Nether.
biomewaypoints.config.searchAgainDistanc: How far (in blocks) you go before the biomes are searched for again from where you are.
Hills of terracotta in bands of color over red sand, with dead bushes and cacti. Gold ore is more common here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.bamboo_ju: A jungle thick with bamboo, where pandas and parrots live.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.basalt_de: A rough Nether land of basalt and blackstone pillars, with lava and magma. Ash falls all the time.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.beach.des: The sandy strip between land and the ocean, where turtles lay their eggs.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.birch_for: A forest of birch trees only.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.cherry_gr: Mountain meadows of cherry trees with pink petals on the ground. Pigs and bees live here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.cold_ocea: A cool ocean with gravel on the floor; salmon swim here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.crimson_f: A Nether forest of crimson fungi and nylium, where hoglins and piglins roam.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.dappled_f: A forest of trees with red and orange leaves.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.dark_fore: A dense forest of dark oaks and huge mushrooms where little light reaches the ground. Woodland mansions stand here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.deep_cold: The deep part of a cold ocean. Ocean monuments can be found here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.deep_dark: A dark cave deep underground, covered in sculk. Ancient cities lie here, and the warden comes when it is woken.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.deep_froz: The deep part of a frozen ocean, with icebergs and ocean monuments.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.deep_luke: The deep part of a lukewarm ocean. Ocean monuments can be found here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.deep_ocea: The deep part of the ocean, with ocean monuments and shipwrecks.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.desert.de: A flat land of sand and sandstone with cacti and dead bushes. Desert villages, pyramids and wells are found here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.dripstone: Caves full of pointed dripstone hanging from the ceiling and rising from the floor.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.end_barre: The low, bare edges of the End's outer islands.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.end_highl: The high middle of the End's outer islands, where chorus plants grow and End cities stand.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.end_midla: The slopes of the End's outer islands, between the highlands and the barrens.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.eroded_ba: Badlands with tall spires of terracotta.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.flower_fo: A forest full of flowers of many kinds.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.forest.de: A common forest of oaks and birches.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.frozen_oc: An ocean whose surface is frozen, with icebergs. Polar bears may wander on the ice.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.frozen_pe: Mountain peaks of snow, packed ice and ice.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.frozen_ri: A river with a frozen surface.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.grove.des: A snowy forest of spruces on the slopes below the peaks, where foxes live.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.ice_spike: A snowy plain with tall spikes of packed ice.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.jagged_pe: Sharp, snowy mountain peaks with bare stone.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.jungle.de: A dense jungle of tall trees with vines, cocoa and melons. Jungle temples are found here, and parrots and ocelots live here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.lukewarm_: A lukewarm ocean with a sandy floor; tropical fish and pufferfish swim here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.lush_cave: Green caves of moss, azaleas, hanging vines with glow berries and clay pools. Axolotls live here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.mangrove_: A muddy swamp of mangrove trees with roots in the water. Frogs live here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.meadow.de: A grassy, flowery field on mountain slopes, with lone trees and beehives.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.mushroom_: Islands of mycelium with huge mushrooms, where mooshrooms live and hostile mobs do not spawn.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.nether_wa: The common land of the Nether, of netherrack with lava seas.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.ocean.des: The open ocean, with seagrass and kelp on the floor and shipwrecks and ruins.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.old_growt: A forest of very tall birch trees.
A taiga of huge spruces with podzol and mossy boulders on the ground.
A taiga of huge spruces with podzol on the ground.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.pale_gard: A pale, misty forest of pale oaks with hanging pale moss. Creakings come out at night.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.plains.de: Flat grassland with few trees, where villages, horses and many animals are found.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.river.des: A river winding through the land; salmon swim here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.savanna.d: Dry grassland with acacia trees, where villages, horses and donkeys are found.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.savanna_p: A high, flat savanna above the land around it.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.small_end: Small floating islands of end stone in the void of the End.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.snowy_bea: A beach covered in snow, by a cold sea.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.snowy_pla: Flat land covered in snow with few trees. Igloos and snowy villages are found here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.snowy_slo: Snowy mountain slopes with powder snow, where goats live.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.snowy_tai: A snowy forest of spruces, where foxes and wolves live.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.soul_sand: A blue-lit Nether valley of soul sand and soul soil with bone fossils. Skeletons, ghasts and endermen roam.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.sparse_ju: A jungle with trees farther apart and more grass.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.stony_pea: Mountain peaks of stone and calcite without snow.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.stony_sho: A rocky coast of stone where the land meets the ocean.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.swamp.des: Shallow water and wet land with oaks covered in vines and lily pads. Witch huts and slimes are found here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.taiga.des: A cool forest of spruces with ferns, where wolves and foxes live and villages are found.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.the_end.d: The main island of the End, with obsidian pillars and the ender dragon.
Nothing at all: the usual world generation does not make it; superflat presets use it.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.warm_ocea: A warm, shallow ocean with coral reefs and sea pickles; tropical fish swim here.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.warped_fo: A Nether forest of warped fungi and nylium where endermen roam; one of the safer places in the Nether.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.windswept: Windswept hills with spruces and oaks.
Windswept hills with patches of gravel.
High, rough hills of stone and grass, with emerald ore underground and llamas.
A savanna of strange, steep, jagged hills.
biomewaypoints.biome.minecraft.wooded_ba: Badlands with an upper level of grass and oak trees.
